qualifier: nuclear beta-catenin-TCF transcription and its repression
name: Beta-catenin-TCF transcription and its negative regulation
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt output at the beta-catenin-TCF transcriptional step and its restraint (target-gene repression, complex deactivation, APC/AXIN lesions), whereas confusables cover ligand secretion, FZD/LRP/DVL receptor-level events and destruction-complex disassembly.

qualifier: regulation by MHC class I recognition (KIR, class Ib)
name: NK cell cytotoxicity and its MHC class I-receptor regulation
rationale: Members cover NK (and T cell) cytotoxic killing, its positive and negative regulation, KIR-cluster and NK receptor modules and MHC class I/Ib presentation, while confusables add T cell activation/proliferation or dendritic cell and costimulation tolerance programmes.

qualifier: response to replication-blocking drugs (camptothecin, hydroxyurea) and DNA-protein crosslinks
name: DNA replication and response to replication-blocking drugs
rationale: Members combine replication initiation and S-phase replication with responses to topoisomerase poison, hydroxyurea and DNA-protein crosslink repair, whereas confusables emphasise DNA topology, R-loops, fork reversal and telomere maintenance.

qualifier: endocytic recycling and endosome tubulation
name: Endocytic recycling and endosomal membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane-endosome transport, receptor and endocytic recycling, endosome tubulation, clathrin uncoating and associated vesicle and lipid-flippase machinery, while confusables centre on Golgi export, constitutive secretion and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation.

core: Unusual amino acid and residue modifications
qualifier: hydroxylation and translation-factor diphthamide/hypusine
name: Rare residue modifications including diphthamide, hypusine and hydroxylation
rationale: Members are specialised residue modifications (hydroxylation, diphthamide, hypusine, formylglycine, selenocysteine, wybutosine, oxidation) largely affecting translation machinery, distinct from methylation (C1), translation termination/decay (C2), RNA modification (C3) and canonical translation (C4).

qualifier: control of heart rate, contractility and blood pressure
name: Catecholamine control of heart rate, contractility and blood pressure
rationale: Members concern epinephrine/norepinephrine release control and its cardiostimulatory and pressor effects, while confusables focus on alpha-2 adrenergic, adenylate cyclase-inhibitory and insulin-secretion signalling.

qualifier: chaperone gene induction and beta-cell apoptosis
name: ER unfolded protein response: chaperone induction, beta-cell survival
rationale: All members belong to the ER UPR (ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3 arms, stress translational control, beta-cell apoptosis), whereas confusables add mitochondrial stress, HRI/GCN2 integrated stress response and PERK inhibition.

qualifier: ABCA1-mediated phospholipid/cholesterol efflux to apoA-I
name: ABCA1-mediated lipid efflux and nascent HDL assembly
rationale: Members cover apoA-I signalling, phospholipid efflux, ABCA1 function and HDL particle assembly, while confusables add HDL/LDL remodelling, LXR regulation and macrophage foam-cell/cholesterol storage control.

qualifier: pre-rRNA spacer cleavage
name: Pre-rRNA spacer cleavage and proliferation housekeeping genes
rationale: Half the members are pre-rRNA cleavage/processing and ribosome assembly steps and the rest are growth/proliferation housekeeping modules (RB1/BCL2L1, mitochondrial, polycomb, mitotic, inner cell mass), lacking the Pol I/III transcription, splicing and MYC-target content of confusables.

qualifier: synapse pruning and dendritic spine remodelling
name: Microglia-mediated synapse and dendritic spine remodelling
rationale: Members combine microglial differentiation, proliferation, migration and activation with synapse pruning, spine maintenance and amyloid-beta response, while confusables emphasise astrocytes, glial apoptosis, DAP12, apoptotic-cell clearance or reelin signalling.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte growth, proliferation and myocardial wall morphogenesis
name: Cardiomyocyte growth, proliferation and myocardial wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and ventricular/trabecular myocardium plus related cardiac smooth muscle growth, while confusables add endocardium, septum, valve and conduction-system development.

core: Male gonad and germ cell development
qualifier: germ cell migration/meiosis entry with Sertoli and Leydig cells
name: Germ cell development and testicular somatic cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover primordial germ cell migration, proliferation, meiosis activation and seminiferous tubule, Sertoli and Leydig cell development, distinct from oocyte maturation, sex determination, spermatid structure and ovarian/gonadotropin confusables.

qualifier: with release of cohesion during mitosis and meiosis
name: Mitotic and meiotic chromosome condensation
rationale: Members centre on prophase/prometaphase chromosome condensation and its promotion, with negative regulation of cohesion and cytokinesis, whereas confusables focus on cohesin loading, cohesion establishment, CENP-A deposition and nuclear envelope dynamics.

qualifier: ureteric bud and nephric duct morphogenesis, kidney growth control
name: Ureteric bud branching and kidney growth control
rationale: Members cover nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching with regulation of kidney proliferation, size and progenitor maintenance, while confusables add intermediate mesoderm, renal vesicle and nephron tubule segment development.

qualifier: GAP-mediated and feedback attenuation, pathway mutants
name: RAS-ERK signalling attenuation by GAPs and feedback
rationale: Members concern RAS-ERK pathway activity and its termination (RAS GAPs, NF1, ERK inactivation, negative feedback, tyrosine dephosphorylation) and RAS/MAPK mutants, whereas confusables emphasise RAF activation or PI3K/AKT and receptor-specific RTK signalling.

qualifier: NGF-TRKA and NTF3-TRKC
name: NGF-TRKA and NTF3-TRKC neurotrophin signalling
rationale: Members are TRKA and TRKC activation and their RAS, PLCG1, PI3K, ERK5, STAT3 and CREB outputs, distinct from the TRKB/BDNF (C2) and p75NTR (C3) confusables.

qualifier: actin cytoskeleton and dendritic spine/filopodium control
name: Postsynaptic actin remodelling and dendritic spine structure
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin organisation, PSD maintenance, spine and filopodium morphogenesis and receptor delivery to the postsynapse, while confusables emphasise dendrite arborization, EPHB signalling and cell polarity.

qualifier: growth factor (TGFb/SMAD, PDGF, KRAS) and mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ drive
name: Fibroblast activation by growth factors and mechanical cues
rationale: Members combine TGFb/SMAD2/3, PDGF, KRAS and FOSL signatures, fibroblast proliferation, paracrine signalling and mechanoresponsive stromal modules, whereas confusables are dominated by ECM composition, adhesion or PDGFR pathway regulation.

qualifier: RNA polymerase III and snRNA genes
name: RNA polymerase III and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members are RNA polymerase III initiation, elongation and termination plus snRNA transcription by Pol II/III, distinct from confusables containing Pol I rRNA transcription, 5S rRNA, rRNA processing and translation initiation.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling to ERK
qualifier: ALK/LTK
name: ALK/LTK receptor autophosphorylation and ERK activation
rationale: Members concern ALK and LTK receptor tyrosine autophosphorylation and downstream ERK activation, whereas confusables add PI3K/AKT, IGF1R/IRS or PDGF/YAP stromal content.

qualifier: myelination and nodal/paranodal domain assembly
name: Myelination and node of Ranvier axon-glia organisation
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, sodium channel clustering, paranodal junctions, neurofascin/NrCAM/L1-ankyrin interactions and glial responses, while confusables emphasise axon regeneration and glial fate/proliferation.

qualifier: calcium sensing and store-operated calcium entry
name: Calcium ion sensing and store-operated calcium entry
rationale: Members concern detecting and responding to calcium and activating store-operated and voltage-gated calcium influx, distinct from confusables on cytosolic calcium removal, Na/Ca exchange and ER/ryanodine calcium release.

qualifier: of nuclear substrate classes rather than the conjugation machinery
name: SUMOylation of nuclear protein substrates
rationale: Members are SUMOylation of specific substrate groups (RNA-binding, nuclear envelope, replication, repair, chromatin, cofactor proteins) and Ran-mediated mitosis, whereas confusables cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and transcription factors.

qualifier: chloride-coupled SLC12 and SLC26 exchangers and their disorders
name: Chloride and inorganic anion transporters and their disorders
rationale: Members are SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC26 anion exchangers (iodide, oxalate, sulfate) and their genetic diseases with linked K+ channels, distinct from bicarbonate transporters, aquaporins/CFTR and Na/H exchanger confusables.

qualifier: ligand binding, isoforms and activating mutants of FGFR1-4
name: FGFR ligand binding, downstream cascades and activating mutants
rationale: Nearly all members are FGFR1-4 ligand binding, isoform splicing, FRS/SHC/PI3K/PLC cascades and point/amplification mutants, distinguishing it from other RTK (ERBB, MET, ALK, KIT, FLT3) and oncogenic-fusion confusables.
